title: Routines & output tests
unavailable: Guided routines are unavailable for this car / protocol. They are experimental, profile-driven and CAN-only — a generic ELM327 cannot run VAG basic settings on K-line cars (that needs KWP1281, which it cannot speak).
subtitle: ⚠ Experimental — actuates components / runs module routines. Read each description.
unlockHelp: Off = browse only. Interlocks are enforced live before every start.

row.lockedNote: This module asks for security access and no plugin is installed: the routine is attempted unlocked and the module decides.
row.attemptAnyway: Attempt anyway (unverified — not expected to work)
row.confirmText: The app will check the interlocks (engine/speed) live and refuse to start if they are not met. Confirm you have read the description above.

interlock.rpmUnreadable: Cannot verify the engine is off — RPM is unreadable.
interlock.engineOff: Engine must be OFF (ignition on) — currently {{rpm}} rpm.
interlock.engineRunning: Engine must be RUNNING at idle.
interlock.speedUnreadable: Cannot verify the vehicle is stationary — speed is unreadable.
interlock.stationary: Vehicle must be stationary — currently {{speed}} km/h.

failure.nrc33: The {{module}} refused this {{kind}} without security access (NRC 0x33). VAG basic settings usually need the ECU unlocked (UDS 0x27 seed/key), and the app ships no seed→key routines. The routine cannot run until you install a security-access plugin for this module (Settings → Security access plugins).
failure.nrc35: Security unlock was rejected (NRC 0x35 invalid key) — the installed plugin’s seed→key routine is wrong for this ECU. Each wrong key counts toward the module’s lockout.
failure.unknownId: The {{module}} does not recognise this routine (id {{id}}, NRC 0x{{nrc}}). This routine ID is unverified for your exact car — it needs confirming from a VCDS "Basic Settings" session or a UDS capture on the real ECU before it will run.
failure.nrc22: The {{module}} rejected the routine because conditions are not correct (NRC 0x22). The engine usually must be warm and at a steady idle with no active faults. Clear stored faults, let it reach operating temperature, and retry.
failure.nrc24: The {{module}} rejected the routine as out of sequence (NRC 0x24) — a required step is missing before it, most often a security-access unlock or a specific diagnostic session. The exact start sequence for this routine is unverified for your car and needs confirming from a VCDS session or a UDS capture.

msg.locked: Locked — enable the routines unlock first.
msg.outputRunning: Output under test — stop to return control to the ECU.
